zh-CN.title: 发送中的气泡保持原貌
items: 乐观消息从出现起就使用最终的个性化气泡
发送动画改为独立覆盖层，不再干扰标签、边框与未来气泡样式

en.title: Bubble styles stay intact while sending
items: Optimistic messages now use their final personalized bubble immediately
Sending animation now lives in an isolated overlay that cannot disturb tags, borders, or future skins
